Barcelona outlines plan to prepare Hamza Abdelkarim

2026-11-27

Egyptian forward Hamza Abdelkarim has returned to training after recovering from muscle discomfort, and he is preparing to face Terrassa with the B team.

Alonso: We are going through a tough moment and we need to find solutions

2026-11-28

2026-11-28

Paris Saint-Germain inquire about signing Alvarez, Atlético confirm stance

2026-11-28

Guardiola confirms his stance on returning to Barcelona: I will not coach them again

2026-11-28

Buffon and Vidal reunite for Carlos Tevez's farewell at La Bombonera

The list of stars for Argentine Carlos Tevez's farewell match at La Bombonera on December 20 continues with the addition of Italian Gianluigi Buffon and Chilean Arturo Vidal, joining Messi, Ronaldo, Agüero, Ferdinand, and Palermo.

Barcelona plan to loan out young talent in January with three clubs on alert

Barcelona are planning to loan out their young Belgian winger Jesse Bisiwu next winter to gain experience and play regularly, with options including Ajax, Rangers, and an undisclosed French club.

Liverpool compete with Real Madrid for Brighton goalkeeper

Liverpool have entered the race to sign Brighton goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen, who is also being pursued by Real Madrid, as both teams consider strengthening their goalkeeping position ahead of next summer.

Napoli move to sign André Luiz with big Mali offer from Corinthians

Napoli have made a formal offer of €17 million to sign André Luiz from Corinthians to strengthen their midfield, but the deal is not yet finalized.

Why is Barcelona the closest to signing Haaland?

Norwegian striker Erling Haaland shows a desire to play in LaLiga in the future, and Barcelona is an attractive destination for him according to journalist José Álvarez, amid doubts about his continuation with Manchester City.

Gabri Veiga defends his time at Al-Ahli

Gabri Veiga, FC Porto midfielder, reaffirmed his commitment to his decision to move to the Saudi Pro League through Al-Ahli, stating that he does not feel regret about it.

River Plate targets Tagliafico and sets priorities for the transfer market

River Plate begins its early moves to strengthen its squad ahead of the 2027 season, negotiating with Inter for defender Palacios and nearing the signing of young Coronel.

Blow for Tottenham as Sávio faces long injury layoff

Brazilian winger Sávio will be out for an extended period for Tottenham due to a new setback with his hamstring, and coach De Zerbi is unsure of his exact return date.

Ethan Mbappé extends contract with LOSC Lille until 2029

LOSC Lille have announced the extension of player Ethan Mbappé's contract, Kylian's younger brother, for two additional seasons until the summer of 2029.

Sørloth injury rules him out for over a month and complicates Juventus' winter plans

Juventus face a setback with Norwegian forward Alexander Sørloth sidelined for over a month due to a muscle injury in his right leg, complicating their plans to strengthen the attack in the winter transfer window.
